items.title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
items.summary: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. items.title: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
items.summary: Multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse task requirements. items.title: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
items.summary: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. items.summary: As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. items.summary: Spatial audio authoring coordinates source decisions with soundfield synthesis. items.title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
items.summary: Localized AI manipulations in long-form videos often affect brief events within otherwise authentic content, making video-level classification insufficient for forensic analysis. Existing audio-visual deepfake benchmarks largely focus on short talking-head clips, while long-form temporal forensics remains predominantly visual. items.summary: Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. items.summary: Learning visual design is essential for prompt enhancement (PE) to turn underspecified user requests into coherent visual specifications for text-to-image (T2I) generation. items.summary: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. items.title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement in the Era of Large Models: Foundation, Risks, Evaluation and Open Challenges
items.summary: AI systems built around large models increasingly use experience and feedback to make persistent changes to models, prompts, memories, tools, and workflows. items.summary: Interactive video world models require coordinated control over viewing perspectives, character actions, and camera motion. items.summary: Native NVFP4 promises to accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs), but achieving stable learning across separate training and sampling engines remains challenging. items.title: Rethinking Video Storage for AI Training: Breaking Cross-Frame Dependencies for Efficient Random Access
items.summary: Large-scale AI training increasingly relies on massive video datasets with random temporal sampling patterns. However, existing video storage paradigms are optimized for sequential playback and employ sophisticated inter-frame reference structures to maximize compression efficiency.
